HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Job Description


Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Daily Responsibilities:

  • Track and trace e-Commerce shipments in North America (sales, returns, trade-ins, replacements) to identify possible delays and create action to troubleshoot (only when needed).
  • Analyze weekly and monthly on-time delivery metrics (OTD) for North America. Proactively collaborate with the Transportation carriers for root cause analysis and action plans.
  • Update, automate (with help of other Google teams) and monitor centralized KPI boards.
  • Resolve escalations from customers and/or internal stakeholders regarding shipment status all the way until resolution by collaborating with Transportation carriers and other Google teams/functions (customer support, Fulfillment, 3PL).
  • Support Google Transportation Operations Manager in transportation master data configurations and troubleshooting.
  • Support Transportation requirements for ongoing cross functional Projects.


Mandatory Skills/Qualifications:

  • Transportation experience, or warehouse experience. (preferably in parcel transportation)
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace and SQL.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving experience, combined with strong business judgment and an ability to present analysis in a clear and compelling manner;
  • Able to navigate ambiguity in work to find issues and work with the appropriate teams to fix/find a solution. ability to follow up with cross functional teams.
  • Must be detail oriented, and able to work under tight deadlines and with a sense of urgency.
  • Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.
  • Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

  • Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).
  • Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.
  • Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.


Required to work in the US PST time zone.


Language Requirement:

Advanced English


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Coordenador(a) Comercial
description:
Junte-se à transformação da saúde no Brasil com a Salux Technology!


A Salux Technology é uma HealthTech 100% brasileira pioneira em soluções inovadoras de gestão de saúde. Desde 1997, nossa missão tem sido democratizar a excelência em saúde, ajudando mais de 250 clientes em todo o país a alcançar resultados excepcionais ao aprimorar a gestão administrativa e clínica.


Em 2021, a Salux passou a fazer parte do Grupo SBPar, o que acelerou nossa jornada de expansão e inovação, consolidando nossa posição como referência em excelência na informatização e soluções tecnológicas para o setor de saúde.


Se você é movido por desafios e quer fazer a diferença em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante evolução, venha crescer conosco e impactar positivamente o futuro da saúde no Brasil!


Principais Responsabilidades:

Estratégia e Execução Comercial:

Liderar as estratégias comerciais dos produtos do Ecossistema Salux.

Executar e desdobrar, no dia a dia, as diretrizes estratégicas definidas pelo Board.

Estruturar, operar e evoluir o modelo de Inside Sales para os produtos do Ecossistema.

Garantir disciplina de execução comercial, previsibilidade de resultados e aderência ao playbook de vendas.

Geração de Demanda e Pré-Vendas:

Liderar iniciativas de geração de demanda inbound e outbound.

Definir critérios objetivos de qualificação (ICP, MQL, SQL).

Garantir produtividade, qualidade das abordagens e conversão em cada etapa do funil.

Vendas e Fechamento:

Apoiar o time na condução de negociações consultivas e vendas de maior complexidade.

Evoluir argumentos de valor, propostas comerciais e posicionamento de mercado.

Garantir consistência entre discurso comercial, proposta de valor e necessidades do cliente.

Relacionamento com Canais, Parceiros e Terceiros:

Desenvolver, manter e fortalecer o relacionamento com canais de venda, parceiros estratégicos e terceiros para divulgação, venda e negociação das soluções que compõem o Ecossistema Salux.

Estruturar e operacionalizar modelos de atuação com canais (indicação, co-venda, revenda ou parcerias estratégicas).

Atuar diretamente em negociações comerciais com parceiros, assegurando alinhamento às diretrizes estratégicas, políticas comerciais e objetivos de crescimento da Salux.

Garantir integração entre canais, time interno de vendas e estratégias de go-to-market do Ecossistema.

Monitorar a performance dos parceiros, qualidade das oportunidades geradas e impacto na receita.

Indicadores, Processos e Governança:

Definir, acompanhar e analisar KPIs de pré-vendas, vendas e canais.

Garantir pipeline confiável, forecast preciso e acompanhamento recorrente dos resultados.

Identificar gargalos no funil e propor ações corretivas baseadas em dados

Contribuir ativamente para a evolução contínua dos processos comerciais do Ecossistema.


Requisitos:

Bacharelado em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Vendas e afins;

Experiência prévia em coordenação de vendas, pré-vendas ou inside sales em empresas de tecnologia (preferencialmente SaaS B2B);

Vivência em geração de demanda, qualificação de leads, canais e fechamento de negócios;

Experiência com gestão de funil de vendas, CRM e indicadores comerciais;

Capacidade de executar estratégias comerciais de forma estruturada e orientada a dados.

Vivência em vendas de ciclos curtos;

Disponibilidade para viagens quando necessário.


Modalidade de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ).

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto, com disponibilidade para viagens sempre que necessário.

title: SDR - Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
Remuneração Fixo + variável - PJ - Vaga Home Office


Estamos em busca de um SDR (Sales Development Representative) para integrar nossa equipe de forma remota, atuando no atendimento inicial de leads via WhatsApp e chamadas de vídeo. Se você tem habilidade em comunicação, é organizado e busca uma oportunidade com potencial de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a meritocracia, essa vaga é para você.


⚠️ É imprescindível ter experiência prévia como SDR.


Habilidades e Qualidades Necessárias:

  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e empatia para entender as necessidades dos leads.
  • Disciplina e organização para gerenciar múltiplos atendimentos de forma eficiente.
  • Ambição e foco em resultados para alcançar e superar objetivos.
  • Capacidade de aprendizado rápido para assimilar os processos e ferramentas da empresa.
  • Resiliência e proatividade frente aos desafios.
  • Ser uma pessoa extremamente focada em resultados.
  • Experiência anterior como SDR é obrigatória.


Responsabilidades:

  • Receber e atender leads que chegam via WhatsApp de forma eficiente e acolhedora.
  • Coletar dados do lead, compreendendo suas necessidades e expectativas.
  • Realizar uma análise inicial para qualificar os leads de acordo com critérios estabelecidos.
  • Encaminhar os dados coletados e análises para o responsável, garantindo uma transição suave e eficaz.
  • Participar da conversa de Handoff com o closer.


Oferecemos:

  • Uma oportunidade de carreira em uma empresa em crescimento.
  • Um ambiente de trabalho meritocrático, onde seu resultado é reconhecido.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades.
  • Remuneração fixa + variável e bônus.

title: Brand Designer Pleno
description:
Cód.57182


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

title: Manager, Site Strategy & Engagement
description:
Established in 1996 and rebranded to Scout in 2024, we built our foundation on planning meetings for numerous organizations within the life sciences sector (Scout Meetings). In response to emerging industry needs, we expanded our services to include Scout Clinical, one of the top providers of clinical trial patient travel and reimbursements, and Scout Academy, our secure, online, on-demand learning management system that ensures global compliance.


Scout is recognized as a leader in our field for innovation in service, attention to detail, our stellar team members, and making the complex easier. If this interests you, we’d love to have you join our rapidly growing team!


Position Summary:

The Manager of Site Strategy and Engagement is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with clinical research sites, ensuring successful site engagement, and performance throughout the clinical trial lifecycle. This role involves collaborating with clinical operations teams, ensuring the utilization of the services scoped, and working to enhance site satisfaction and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:

  • Site Engagement: Identify, assess, and engage with potential clinical research sites in studies contracted to use Scout services, ensuring they are aware of the service and have everything needed to optimize use of the portal.
  • Site Support: Provide guidance and direction to sites and operations team members to drive strategy for continued use of the portal.
  • Site/Study Utilization Monitoring: Monitor site utilization throughout the trial, ensuring portal use and proactively addressing any issues or concerns that may arise at the site level.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Project Managers, Patient Lesions, Site staff, and sponsors, to ensure alignment on site-related needs.
  • Site Relationship Management: Cultivate long-term, productive relationships with clinical sites. Regularly check in with sites to assess their needs, gather feedback, and improve site engagement strategies.
  • Problem Solving & Issue Resolution: Anticipate, identify, and resolve any issues or obstacles at the site level to ensure continued use of the portal.
  • Regional Client Support: Support client conversations with regional specific expertise. Gather local market insights including challenges and recommend how Scout can best support or solve them.
  • Marketing for the region: Support marketing with drafting messaging with an emphasis on local, cultural, economic and regulatory considerations.
  • Complete all required initial and ongoing training within a reasonable or provided timeframe.


The ideal candidate will have the following experience, skills, and knowledge:

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in clinical research or clinical trial management, with a focus on site management or clinical site engagement.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, regulations, and industry best practices.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build rapport with diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple sites and projects simultaneously, with strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese (spoken and written)


Visit our website at or follow us on LinkedIn for other employment opportunities.


WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

title: Senior Go Developer
description:
Senior Go Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a Senior Software Engineer Backend you will be part of a fast-paced, collaborative team developing our attack surface intelligence capabilities. You will be a critical contributor to the development and integration of reconnaissance technologies and products while also moving forward the state of engineering best practices in our cybersecurity platform. If you enjoy pivoting between different problems and meeting new challenges every day while developing solutions that are mission critical to the organization, this role is for you!

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop and integrate cybersecurity testing and analysis systems with best-in-class cybersecurity platform;
  • Build high-performance, resilient, scalable cloud-based software, microservices architecture and containers;
  • Take software through CI/CD all the way to production and own its quality and availability;
  • Utilize GCP platform to build and run highly-available software systems;
  • Identify and resolve performance issues across systems and components;
  • Collaborate on a cross-functional team, working with Product, Operations, and Platform Engineering;
  • Integrate monitoring and alerting capabilities with backend modules to allow proactive improvements to availability and response times;
  • Design, implement and deliver well-tested, scalable, highly available systems;
  • Own and ideate technical solutions for product requirements and user stories;
  • Actively engage and participate in design and code reviews;
  • Offer guidance and support to junior team members, encouraging and cultivating a culture of continuous learning within the team

Essential Skills


  • Experience in distributed-systems and backend software engineering;
  • Strong Golang Required;
  • Strong experience and understanding of microservices, REST API design, gRPC, unit testing, BDD testing;
  • Strong design skills required – UML is a bonus; exposure to Domain Driven Design desirable;
  • Experience with asynchronous messaging technologies such as Google PubSub, Kafka;
  • In depth knowledge of NoSQL and RDBMS technologies;
  • Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Environments (GCP preferred);
  • Experience working on agile teams;
  • Experience developing scalable and observable microservice-based applications
  • Experience with GitOps and DevOps principles, practices and tools;
  • A proven ability to thrive in a collaborative environment involving different stakeholders and subject matter experts.


Highly Desirable Skills


  • Interest in security / penetration testing;
  • Interest in GenAI and LLM technologies.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Executivo Comercial
description:
Descrição da Empresa:


A Compliance for Business é uma consultoria referência em Governança Corporativa, atuando em áreas como Compliance, LGPD, DPO Externo, Canal de Denúncias, Investigações Corporativas e Treinamentos. Ajudamos empresas a estarem em conformidade com as mais rigorosas leis e regulamentos, garantindo a segurança jurídica e de dados dos nossos clientes. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais apaixonados por transformar o mundo corporativo e educar nossos clientes sobre melhores práticas de governança, compliance e privacidade.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Prospectar ativamente e Qualificar leads em diversos canais;
  • Conduzir o processo de vendas consultivas;
  • Realizar reuniões virtuais para apresentar nossas soluções;
  • Negociar com empresas para gerar uma nova venda;
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes estratégicos da carteira, aconselhando as reuniões realizadas para gerar oportunidades de negócios futuros;
  • Fornecer, acompanhar e entregar as documentações possíveis para fechamento da venda (contratos e outros documentos);
  • Acompanhar a ativação desses novos clientes convertidos, garantindo a efetividade da venda feita;
  • Participar de reuniões internas para colaborar com estratégias e alavancar resultados


O que buscamos no seu perfil

  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Proatividade e organização
  • Experiência em vendas de Serviços B2B;
  • Experiência em vendas SaaS B2B
  • Experiência em Prospecção Ativa em diversos canais 
  • Atuação prévia com vendas Outbound


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em metodologia de vendas;
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e com gestão do tempo;
  • Ensino médio completo (superior será um diferencial);
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas digitais (planilhas, e-mail, CRM etc.);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto de segunda à sexta-feira.


O que oferecemos

  • Regime 100% home-office
  • Comissionamento
  • Oportunidade de crescimento dentro de uma empresa em forte expansão.
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo com grande potencial de aprendizado.

title: ServiceNow Technical Consultant
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.

Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.

Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor (a) Senior ServiceNow - App Engine & Now Assist , com forte experiência em App Engine e Now Assist para atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações corporativas, automações inteligentes e soluções baseadas em agentes de IA em um projeto estratégico junto a uma equipe multidisciplinar de analistas, arquitetos e desenvolvedores.


A pessoa selecionada irá atuar em iniciativas avançadas de Hiperautomação e IA, incluindo:

  • Desenvolvimento de soluções para Automação de Processos utilizando a plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando App Engine Studio (Low-code e High-code).
  • Projetar e implementar workflows, flows e integrações (ITSM, App Engine).
  • Desenvolvimento de scripts para melhor aderência de soluções ao negócio.
  • Atuar na criação de soluções com Now Assist , explorando:
  • Assistentes de IA para ITSM, CSM e processos corporativos.
  • Automação de geração de textos, resumos, classificação e suporte a agentes.
  • Uso de modelos generativos integrados à ServiceNow.
  • Desenvolver componentes em UI Builder / Workspace quando necessário.
  • Trabalhar com scripting em JavaScript (Server e Client Side) .
  • Apoiar na definição de arquitetura de soluções e boas práticas de desenvolvimento na plataforma.
  • Participar de refinamentos técnicos, estimativas e definição de MVPs .
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança e governança das aplicações desenvolvidas.
  • Participação em todo o ciclo de vida de soluções :
  • Discovery técnico
  • Desenho e arquitetura de solução
  • Desenvolvimento
  • Testes e Deploy
  • Hypercare, Orquestração e Sustentação
  • Atuação consultiva com áreas de negócio e TI;
  • Apoio à disseminação de boas práticas de COE de Hiperautomação & IA;
  • Atuar como referência técnica ServiceNow no squad de Delivery;


O que buscamos?

  • Profissional com senioridade e experiência comprovada nos itens citados nesta.
  • Capacidade de liderança técnica;
  • Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e inovador;
  • Gosto por ambientes de alta performance, transparência e confiança;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão de soluções aplicadas para os negócios.
  • Comunicação clara com times técnicos e de negócio.
  • Mentalidade de inovação e automação inteligente.

Requisitos da Vaga

  • Experiência comprovada desenvolvimento na plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Experiência comprovada com ServiceNow App Engine / Creator Workflows.
  • Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Flow Designer e IntegrationHub.
  • JavaScript para ServiceNow.
  • Consumo e exposição de APIs REST.
  • Experiência com Virtual Agent, AI Search, Process Automation Designer, Performance Analytics
  • Vivência em projetos de IA aplicada a processos corporativos.
  • App Engine Studio / Application Developer
  • Now Assist Specialist
  • Experiência com metodologia Ágil (Scrum / Kanban);
  • Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  • Atuação em Centros de Excelência de RPA & IA.
  • Graduação em Tecnologia, Engenharia ou Administração.


Conhecimentos que podem ser um diferencial para a vaga:

  • ITSM (IT Service Management)
  • ITBM (IT Business Management)
  • SPM(Strategic Porfolio Management)
  • CSM (Customer Service Management)
  • FSM (Field Service Management)
  • ATF (Automated Task Framework)
  • Base de Conhecimento e Configurações da Plataforma (catálogo, SLA, Business rules, Assigment rule, Scheduled Jobs etc.)
  • Service Portal
  • Experiência na plataforma de RPA & IA Automation Anywhere
  • Certificações: Human Resources (CIS-HRSD), IT Service Management (CIS-ITSM), Customer Service Management (CIS-CSM).
  • Vivência com frameworks de governança em ServiceNow.
  • Conhecimento em UX para ServiceNow Workspaces.
  • Conhecimento em:
  • Python
  • .NET
  • Git
  • Inglês.


Contratação PJ.

title: Arquiteto de Infraestrutura (Plataforma Mainframe)
description:
Procuramos Analista de Suporte Mainframe SR que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Modalidade de Trabalho: Atuação em formato Presencial em São Paulo ou Brasília, de 23:00 às 07:00 (Segunda/Sexta).


Perfil que Buscamos:

- Pessoa Responsável por gerar e customização do sistema operacional em suporte, desenvolvimento, homologação e produção (MVS/ESA OS/390 e Z/OS).

- Instalação de sistema operacional e softwares de apoio ao Z/OS com o uso de SMP/E e Suporte a produtos de apoio a equipes de produção, desenvolvimento e produção.


Nesta função você irá:

- Coletar e analisar informações para desenvolvimento e alteração de sistemas.

- Planejar e implantar expansões de hardware I/O usando a ferramenta HCD - Hardware Configuration Definition.

- Planejar e implementar novas Lpares no complexo operacional.

- Estudo, planejamento e implementação de software voltado ao gerenciamento de Storage.

- Participação do grupo de estudo e implementação do DFSMSHSM em ambiente de suporte, desenvolvimento e produção.

- Definição de catalogos ICF CATALOG, bem como definição e manutenção de aliases e reorganização de catalogos com e sem a ferramenta TACM.

- Analisar performance do ambiente produtivo e sugerir alterações que possam maximizar e otimizar os recursos dando suporte a equipe de performance utilizando a ferrameta MAINVIEW.

- Implantação de manutenção de CF Coupling Facility e estruturas HMC: Criar e alterar configurações de hardware e profiles de ativação de CPU.


Necessário ter:

- Formação superior completa na área de TI.

- Experiência como Analista de Suporte na plataforma Mainframe.

- Atendimento de incidentes.

- Garantir o SLA contratado, manter a disponibilidade da infraestrutura funcionando 24×7 em todos os sites.

- Atuação e customização de Sistema Operacional zOS 2.2/2.4/3.1.

- Especialista da Plataforma Mainframe.

- Domínio de software básico IBM: z/OS (RACF, WLM, OMVS, JES3, TCPIP, VTAM, DFSMS, DFHSM e SMP/E).

- Domínio do software EOS ENTERPRISE OUTPUT SOLUTION, Gerenciador de Relatórios.

- Domínio do software GFS/AFM, Gerenciador de Fitoteca.

- Domínio do software GFS/BETA zSecurity, administrador de RACF.

- Programação em linguagens: Assembler, REXX e JCL.

- Coleta e monitoramento pelo software BMC Mainview.

- Noções básicas de Bancos de Dados DB2 e IMS/DB.

- Noções básicas de arquitetura de rede TCP/IP.


O que você pode esperar de nós

- Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.


O que oferecemos?

SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.E muito mais!


+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração.


Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

title: Estágio Direito
description:
Descrição da Empresa  

A Compliance for Business é uma consultoria referência em Governança Corporativa, atuando em áreas como Compliance, LGPD, DPO Externo, Canal de Denúncias, Investigações Corporativas e Treinamentos. Ajudamos empresas a estarem em conformidade com as mais rigorosas leis e regulamentos, garantindo a segurança jurídica e de dados dos nossos clientes. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais apaixonados por transformar o mundo corporativo e educar nossos clientes sobre melhores práticas de governança, compliance e privacidade.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Organização e acompanhamento de cronogramas de projetos, acompanhando as fases dos projetos em andamento, garantindo que os prazos sejam cumpridos.
  • Análise e revisão de contratos de clientes e parceiros, com foco em conformidade com a LGPD e demais normas de compliance.
  • Auxílio na elaboração de Políticas, termos de uso e outros documentos essenciais para empresas.
  • Apoio nas auditorias, coletando dados e realizando análises jurídicas sobre a adequação de processos.
  • Pesquisa e análise de regulamentações, mantendo-se atualizado sobre as melhores práticas e mudanças legislativas, especialmente relacionadas à LGPD e Compliance.
  • Auxílio no atendimento ao cliente, esclarecendo dúvidas jurídicas e fornecendo suporte técnico em documentos e processos.


Qualificações

  • Cursando Direito (3º ou 4º ano).
  • Habilidade organizacional para acompanhar e manter o controle de cronogramas e prazos dos projetos.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes, com capacidade de trabalhar em múltiplas tarefas.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e oral, capaz de redigir relatórios e documentos jurídicos claros e objetivos.


Conhecimentos

  • Pacote Office Intermediário (Excel e Word);
  • Familiaridade com software de gestão de tarefas;
  • Conhecimento básico em contratos, regulamentações de privacidade e compliance regulatório será um diferencial.


O que oferecemos:

  • Regime 100% home-office
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento em um campo dinâmico e em crescimento, com muito aprendizado na área de Governança Corporativa. 
  • Mentoria contínua de profissionais da área jurídica e de compliance.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico, com participação ativa em projetos desafiadores.
  • Bolsa-auxílio compatível com o mercado, além de benefícios.

Você é apaixonado pelo mercado financeiro e busca um ambiente onde sua autonomia e capacidade de prospecção sejam os motores do seu crescimento?

Na Fincapital - BTG Pactual , estamos expandindo nosso time de talentos. Buscamos profissionais que desejam construir sua própria história e carteira de clientes, contando com o suporte de uma marca líder e uma liderança altamente qualificada.

  • Ecossistema BTG Pactual: Toda a infraestrutura e credibilidade do maior banco de investimentos da América Latina.
  • Geração de Leads: Além da sua prospecção ativa, o escritório possui estratégias para fornecimento de leads adicionais para acelerar seu crescimento.
  • Cultura Empreendedora: Liberdade para construir sua própria carteira com foco total no sucesso do investidor.
  • Apoio financeiro: Bolsa com modelo de mínimo garantido nos primeiros meses, para dar mais tranquilidade na fase de montagem de carteira.



O que buscamos em você:


  • Perfil Hunter: Energia e resiliência para prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado.
  • Visão empreendedora: Desejo de gerir o próprio negócio e crescer sem limites de remuneração.
  • Foco no Cliente: Habilidade para construir relacionamentos de confiança e entender as necessidades reais dos investidores.

Etapas de Seleção


  • Entrevista com o Recrutamento e Seleção;
  • Entrevista com Sócios;
  • Processo de Compliance.

description:

Our client provides a cloud-based, ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver Level 3 customer support for our client's industry-leading software products
  • Triage reported, end-user customer incidents
  • Work technical issues and support the direct client feedback loop process
  • Help secure existing revenue by means of customer retention
  • Provide incident queue management
  • Utilize troubleshooting skills
  • Help manage complex issues and drive escalations to resolution
  • Build and demonstrate cross-application knowledge among the client's core application modules
  • Push the client's software to the limit, making sure it is efficient, intuitive, and best-in-class
  • Gain experience in the oil and gas industry; including economic, accounting, and finance knowledge


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • 3 to 5 years of Level 3 software support experience
  • Basic to intermediate SQL skills
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite
  • A drive to continue learning in the energy business and the client's software
  • Advanced problem-solving skills
  • Ability to triage and actively manage a support queue
  • Innate passion for customer service
  • Dependability and ability to manage as well as prioritize concurrent tasks
  • Must be available for an on-call rotation
  • Ability to work U.S. CST business hours
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience creating manuals, training documentation, and interactive training materials for software applications
  • Experience providing software support and troubleshooting for SaaS applications
  • Experience in reproducing issues in a test environment prior to production deployment
  • Experience in the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Backend Developer (Python, SDK)
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


This is a full-time remote role for a Senior Backend Developer in Brazil. You will join one of our North American client's engineering team to maintain, design, implement, test, and deploy new features in their Python SDK as well as fix bugs, improve, and update its existing functionalities. As an experienced developer, you will be responsible for writing great documentation, doing demos, and mentoring others. You will participate in the client's team ceremonies and other sessions.


Must Have Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • Experience working independently and remotely.
  • Strong experience with Python.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with Public API and Python SDK on the backend implementation side.
  • Familiarity with FastAPI is a plus since one of the tasks ahead is to tighten up the client endpoints so that the developer generates well-designed and comprehensive OpenAPI specifications.
  • SDK coding for other developers


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.

title: Data Analyst | Ecommerce (Full-time Remote, BR)
description:
About Us:

Carepod is a premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re growing fast and building a data-driven culture where insights actually shape decisions.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who thinks like a business partner, not just a report builder.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain dashboards & projection tools such as sales, marketing, inventory, etc.
  • Analyze ecommerce & marketing data (Shopify, ads, reviews)
  • Identify trends in conversion, retention, and customer behavior
  • Support leadership with clear insights and recommendations
  • Answer real business questions, fast


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years experience as a Data Analyst
  • Strong SQL + Excel / Google Sheets
  • Experience with dashboards & KPIs
  • Exeprience with AI Automations such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, n8n, Make, Airtable, etc.
  • Ecommerce or DTC experience preferred
  • Comfortable communicating insights in English
  • Bonus: Python, BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)


Why Carepod

  • Direct exposure to leadership
  • Real impact on decisions
  • International business experience
  • Fully remote, long-term opportunity


What We Offer:

 • Fully remote work environment

 • Competitive salary

 • Flexible PTO policy

 • Opportunity to grow with a scaling e-commerce brand

 • A supportive, collaborative, and agile team culture


⸻


To Apply:

  • Send your resume and a short note about why you’re a great fit

Nossos Valores

  • Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.

Como Lead Software Engineer, você é responsável por impulsionar a visão técnica por trás de aplicações modernas e escaláveis, enquanto orienta uma equipe de engenharia de alta performance. Você prospera na interseção entre arquitetura, desenvolvimento prático e mentoria, equilibrando decisões estratégicas com a paixão por construir software de excelência.

Lead Software Engineer | Atividades do Dia a Dia

  • Liderar o design e desenvolvimento de aplicações complexas e escaláveis usando .NET e frameworks modernos de JavaScript, como Angular ou React.

  • Arquitetar e manter sistemas na nuvem seguros, de alta disponibilidade e otimizados para desempenho.

  • Experiência prática no deploy e otimização de aplicações na AWS ou outras grandes plataformas de nuvem.

title: AWS Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções de Ciência de Dados e IA Generativa, com foco em arquiteturas RAG;
  • Executar demandas priorizadas pelo Product Owner, realizando detalhamento técnico e definição de abordagens de Machine Learning e GenAI;
  • Desenvolver, sustentar e monitorar pipelines de dados, modelos de ML, APIs e fluxos de IA;
  • Validar performance de sistemas RAG;
  • Implementar pipelines de ingestão e indexação de textos em bancos vetoriais;
  • Construir APIs e fluxos utilizando LangChain, LangGraph e integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações conteinerizadas e arquiteturas serverless em AWS e Azure;
  • Produzir visualizações e indicadores para análise crítica e validação de resultados;
  • Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura, segurança, escalabilidade e boas práticas em nuvem.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Python e bibliotecas Pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow e PyTorch;
  • Experiência prática com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs), soluções de IA Generativa e arquiteturas RAG;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de avaliação de NLP e IA (similaridade semântica, BLEU, ROUGE);
  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem AWS, incluindo os serviços: S3, Lambda, RDS, SageMaker, Parameter Store e Secret Manager;
  • Desenvolvimento de pipelines em bancos vetoriais (AWS OpenSearch);
  • Construção de APIs utilizando LangChain e LangGraph;
  • Integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Uso de Azure Document Intelligence para processamento de documentos.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em DevOps aplicado a ML/IA (MLOps).

title: Analytics Engineer - Especialista I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos, resilientes e de referência técnica para a tribo;
  • Atua como referência na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Lidera iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
  • Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
  • Atua como mentor(a) e referência técnica para analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
  • Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
  • Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;
  • Capacidade comprovada de liderar projetos cross-times, influenciar decisões estratégicas e atuar como ponto focal técnico em fóruns executivos e de negócio.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

£70,000 - £90,000

Remote - Brazil (You will need to work UK time zone)


You already know how to build software that works.


What you might be missing is the chance to build something that matters, where the details count and the users notice when you get it right.


This role is for an engineer who cares how things look, how they behave, and how they hold up when real money and real users are involved.


Why you’ll love it here:

  • You’ll own real parts of the product, not just tickets
  • The UI has to be precise and trusted, not “close enough”
  • You’ll work across the full stack with real influence over decisions
  • The product sits between traditional finance expectations and onchain systems
  • You’ll build for institutional and high net worth users who demand clarity and reliability


Who this isn’t for:

This isn’t a role for someone who wants a narrow remit, loose UI standards, or to ship features without thinking end to end.


If you prefer clear tickets, minimal ownership, or letting AI do the thinking for you, this will feel uncomfortable.


Day to day:

You’ll be building and refining a production platform used to manage onchain assets.


That means turning product direction and designs into polished, accurate UI, then wiring it properly into APIs, databases, and background workflows.


The split is genuinely full stack. You’ll spend meaningful time on the frontend, but you’re also expected to contribute confidently on the backend so features are built end to end, not in isolation.


Performance, maintainability, and correctness matter because this platform is already live and evolving.


The Business:

The business is a FinTech fund building onchain banking infrastructure for institutional capital.

It operates where stablecoins, DeFi lending, automation, and risk management meet.


The focus is usability and trust, bringing institutional-grade expectations into onchain finance, with active engagement from major financial institutions.


Requirements:

  • Strong full stack experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript
  • Proven ability to ship precise, production-quality UI
  • Solid SQL knowledge with Postgres and an ORM such as Prisma
  • Experience designing APIs and backend workflows, including orchestration tools like Temporal
  • Understanding of ERC-4626 and DeFi lending markets such as Aave or Morpho
  • Confident, structured use of LLM tools like Cursor or Claude Code
  • FinTech experience preferred
  • Able to travel freely across Europe


If you want ownership, technical breadth, and the chance to build a mature system people genuinely rely on, this is worth a conversation.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Liderar a definição técnica e a evolução da estratégia de Data Lake, garantindo uma arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
  • Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;
  • Implementar ferramentas e práticas que permitam a escalabilidade da modelagem de dados voltada à decisão estratégica;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida da aquisição de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os stakeholders;
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Tecnologia.
  • Sólida experiência em pipelines e Big Data (Python/Java/Scala);
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Perfil autônomo, analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.


Nossos benefícios:


O Que Temos Para Você

title: Analista Desenvolvedor Fullstack
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Estamos buscando um profissional com:


Backend e Persistência de Dados

* Sólida experiência com EJB (Enterprise JavaBeans) e JPA (Java Persistence API).

* Atuação com bancos de dados relacionais, incluindo modelagem, otimização de consultas e manipulação avançada de dados.

* Desenvolvimento de queries nativas para bancos relacionais.

Arquitetura e Boas Práticas

* Aplicação de design patterns e boas práticas voltadas a arquiteturas escaláveis, performáticas e sustentáveis.

Integrações e Mensageria

* Experiência com filas JMS.

* Desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs REST, com foco em desempenho, segurança e padronização.

Infraestrutura e DevOps

* Experiência com servidores de aplicação IBM WebSphere.

* Utilização de Maven para gerenciamento de dependências e build.

* Controle de versão utilizando Git.

Qualidade e Monitoramento

* Forte experiência na criação e manutenção de testes unitários, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e manutenibilidade do código.

* Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise e monitoramento de logs, com preferência por Graylog.

Frontend e Desenvolvimento Web

* Conhecimento em Angular 2+ e arquitetura de Microfrontend, para construção de aplicações modulares e escaláveis.


Benefícios que oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional experience in C# and Angular or React.js to support the development, migration, and ongoing evolution of a platform. This role will play a key part in delivering new product initiatives, maintaining existing systems, and implementing a modernized architecture across multiple verticals.

The ideal candidate is technically strong across the stack, comfortable working within an established architectural vision, and proactive in taking ownership of implementation and delivery.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI powering solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain full-stack features across web applications and backend services
  • Implement solutions aligned with architectural guidance provided by the architecture team
  • Contribute to the development of new products while maintaining and enhancing existing systems
  • Support the migration of legacy components into a modern microservices-based architecture
  • Build and maintain scalable backend services using C# , .NET , and SQL
  • Develop and maintain front-end functionality using Angular , with the
  • ability to quickly learn and adapt as needed
  • Collaborate across multiple product verticals and support a growing pipeline of new initiatives
  • Take technical ownership of assigned areas, leading implementation efforts and driving work forward
  • Partner closely with Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams to deliver on the broader technical vision


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience as a software engineer in a full-stack capacity
  • Strong backend experience with C# , .NET , and SQL
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining microservices-based systems
  • Front-end development experience, ideally with Angular , or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Experience working within an established architecture and implementing designs created by an architecture team
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work across multiple projects and verticals
  • Proactive, energetic mindset with a willingness to take ownership and lead by example


Preferred Experience

  • Experience participating in large-scale system migrations or platform modernization efforts
  • Exposure to cloud-based environments and distributed systems
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments with multiple concurrent initiatives


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·        Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·        5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·        Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·        Brazil-based ( fully remote )

·        Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·        Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·        Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·        Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·        High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·        Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV  in English , and  one paragraph  describing how you would approach the  first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·        Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·        5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·        Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·        Brazil-based ( fully remote )

·        Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·        Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·        Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·        Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·        High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·        Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with Investment decision makers such as Investment Manager, Portfolio Manager, Financial Advisor or Analyst who are working in investment bank, private equity firms, asset management firms or family offices.



Qualifications:

  • The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the global awareness of city’s attractiveness in trade, investment and partnership. I believe your opinions and expertise would be valuable for our study and I wonder if you’re interested in taking part.
  • Job titles: Head of Investment, Portfolio Manager or Investment Manager, Wealth Manager, Wealth Advisor, Analyst.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 30-minute interview conducted via MS Teams and the interview can be held in either English or Portuguese.
  • Please note that, before the final interview, there'll be a 10-minute quick online screener to share more details on the research and to check that this is relevant to you.


Compensation package - BRL 1100 for a 30-minute online interview.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
About Growave

Growave is a Shopify retention platform that helps brands grow through Loyalty & Rewards, Referrals, Wishlist, Reviews, and Instagram UGC. Thousands of merchants worldwide use Growave, including Lego, Crocs, Dermalogica, Unilever, Sony, and Aldo.


The Role

We’re looking for a Technical Support Specialist to help Shopify merchants get the most out of Growave. You’ll troubleshoot technical issues, customize Shopify themes, and work closely with Product and Engineering teams to deliver smooth solutions.


Employment Type

Contractor (Contract) – you are responsible for your own taxes and social contributions.


Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot technical issues on Shopify storefronts
  • Customize Shopify themes (Liquid) for Growave widgets and integrations
  • Communicate with clients via Intercom, email, and calls
  • Create and edit scripts for Reviews, Loyalty, and Wishlist features
  • Debug client-side issues using browser developer tools
  • Collaborate with Developers on complex technical cases
  • Read and modify code in Shopify + Growave environment


Requirements

  • 1+ year of experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Shopify theme customization experience (Liquid)
  • Familiarity with Shopify apps and ecosystem
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication and self-management skills


Languages

  • English and Portuguese (required )
  • Additional languages are a plus


What We Offer

  • Fully remote work
  • Paid vacation and public holidays in your country
  • Work on a fast-growing global Shopify product
  • Collaboration with an experienced international team

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
About Us

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


About Your Team

At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you will collaborate with business and product teams to validate hypotheses, answer complex business questions, help the company in uncertain scenarios, perform data experiments, and disseminate actionable insights.


About You

You will take the lead in exploring data and cross-business variables, uncovering patterns and trends, identifying new data sources, and delivering valuable insights to various departments.


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute complex data analyses using statistical techniques and modeling to validate business hypotheses.
  • Detect patterns, trends and anomalies in data and translate them into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and business growth.
  • Serve as a key expert in data analysis, providing guidance and best practices to team members and stakeholders across the company.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Strong curiosity for uncovering insights from data.
  • Proven experience in delivering data studies focused on generating and sharing actionable data.
  • Deep understanding of statistical methods, including hypothesis testing and statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency in SQL for extracting data directly from source systems.
  • Sharp critical thinking and analytical problem-solving abilities.
  • Enjoy working in a dynamic environment with fast learning and deliveries.
  • Advanced English proficiency (conversational, listening, writing.)


Nice to Have:

  • Ability to perform data cleaning and processing steps using Python or R languages.
  • Hands-on experience in building Machine Learning models.


This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: IT Software License Specialist | Software Asset Management | Enterprise Architecture | ServiceNow SAM
description:
Role: IT Software License Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 6 Months+ (with a possibility of extension)

Work Hours: UST Time

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location: 100% Remote


Join our Software Asset Management (SAM) team under Enterprise Architecture and help drive license compliance, cost optimization, and effective software governance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze software usage to identify underutilized licenses and cost-saving opportunities
  • Manage license tracking, entitlements, and usage across systems
  • Support internal/external software audits and license compliance
  • Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and license procurement
  • Work with SAM tools (ServiceNow) and vendor software portals
  • Create reports and dashboards for stakeholders


Requirements:

  • 14 years of relevant experience
  • Associate’s degree required; Bachelor’s preferred (IT/CS or related)
  • Strong understanding of software licensing and SAM methodologies
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Experience with ServiceNow Software Asset Management preferred

title: EOS Linux Server Manager (Inglês Avançado)
description:
LINUX SERVER MANAGER FOR ENHANCED OPERATIONS SERVICE


We are looking for professionals with extensive experience in Linux and Unix, and public Cloud, for support in Professional Services.

The ideal candidate has deep understanding of Cloud operations, being able to give L3 support, acting in a big team, dedicated to help clients. We need someone able to solve critical and high-impact issues independently.

A customer first mindset is a must.


• Participate in Major incident handling, troubleshoot service request failures, downtime extensions, long running ongoing incidents for a customer. (Level 3 support)

• Quick responses during escalations, take proactive steps to avoid escalations, identifying and driving initiatives to improve the operation and stability for our customer system

• Drive initiatives to standardize and simplify server operations.

• Continuous improvement methodologies: root cause analysis for Service requests failures/outages, performance issues

• Analyze root-causes of the failures (if known) in achieving the KPIS and define a corrective action plan, with well-defined mitigation steps.

• Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams, collaborating with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.

• Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities

• Streamline standard operating procedures by focusing on automation enhancements.

• Proactive Operation services for the customer and service on-demand with timely alert reduction program to all the stakeholders involving the customer.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

  • PJ


Se interessou, encaminhe seu currículo também para:


Requisitos Mandatórios:

Experiência comprovada nos seguintes pontos:

Google Analytics (GA4): Avançado/Especialista em configuração, migração, auditoria e uso estratégico da plataforma (Relatórios Padrão e Análises Exploratórias).
